narrative.details:
Return to your own tribe and let them know of your victory here.

Show them your trophy, and bask in the glory...
narrative.objectives: Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: So, this is the skull of the fiercest furbolg threat in Ashenvale?I am more than pleased with your abilities, adventurer. The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. I hope we can rely on you again in the future to help our people.I shall put this skull and Dartol's Rod in a place of reverence for others to see.Teronis would be proud. Thank you again.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Sentinels do what they can here in Ashenvale, but it's thanks to friends like you that we have gained the ground we have.
